card.name: Buying and selling words before the item
card.fires_on: Buy, sell, purchase and the words right after them (a, your, new, similar) in commercial text about buying goods. Also some prices and product lists.

modes.label: Buy/sell verbs
modes.description: The verb buy or sell itself, just before the thing being traded.
modes.example: is preparing to invade the Turkish market. From the WSJ: On Tuesday, Nissin said it will spend $23.5 million to<< buy>> a 50% stake in pasta

modes.label: Words after buy
modes.description: A determiner or adjective right after buy or purchase, before the product noun.
modes.example: Therefore, this increased pain will reduce your likelihood of purchasing a<< new>> television. This is similar to the pizza

modes.label: Prices and goods lists
